usedFor: A new Liliphant meeting summary creates a lead in Zoho CRM.

bestTemplate.name: “New Analyzed Meeting Summary” in Liliphant, then “Create a lead” in Zoho CRM
bestTemplate.why: “Create a lead” takes a layout and assignment rule, so the lead is routed on creation.

watchOut: “New Analyzed Meeting Summary” is set for one chosen company, so only its meetings create leads.
